author: Catherine Chidgey
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Justine and her classmates become instantly captivated by their vibrant, magnetic new teacher, all of them vying for special favor. But as a series of thefts plagues the school, Justine develops a persistent, unsettling feeling that something is deeply amiss. Amidst a cascade of dark revelations and the heavy burden of guilt, young Justine is forced to choose where her true allegiances belong.
title: Pet
